D37 live (review R7): level 1 snow at -18 C with 20 m/s of airflow over the glass reaches exposure 0.9 or more with the shipped wind reference (20 m/s); the build time is shortened. The ceiling is level * cold * (0.55 + 0.45 * airflow / 20 m/s) * 1.25: exposure 1 needs about 11 m/s of airflow, without wind it stops at 0.69

D37 live (review R7): the same snowfall without wind settles at the wind-free ceiling 0.6875 (between 0.6 and 0.75; the shortened build time reaches it within 14 s). Whether a natural Kerbin blizzard has the wind for exposure 1 is read from the first real storm (owner), not from this forced field

No Kerbin air is that cold: whether the IVA windows should frost at ordinary cold is an owner decision (T4)

D37 (R1, required): the IVA has a valid interior mask whose coverage lies between 0.005 and 0.995, or needs none (the internal camera draws past the upscaler). A 0 means no way of taking the depth worked and the renderer's policy applied (quad where no upscaler runs, otherwise no frost)
D37 record (R1): the mask coverage with the way pinned to 0 (BeforeForwardAlpha, depth texture asked for); -1: no reading came back in 5 s
D37 record (R1): coverage with way 1 (BeforeForwardAlpha as the camera has it)
D37 record (R1): coverage with way 2 (AfterForwardOpaque)
D37 record (R1): coverage with way 3 (BeforeImageEffects)
D37 A/B control (R1): two pictures of the upscaled image with the frost not drawn, 8 frames apart, differ in at most 2 % of the pixels (10 % luminance change); what moves by itself in the cabin

D37 A/B (R1): with the frost drawn by the host composite at full exposure (-123 C), at least 1 % of the pixels differ from the picture without it by more than 10 % luminance; a 0 means the composite is not in the image the tap sees (not drawn, wrong camera or hidden under the interior)
D37 A/B (R1): the share of changed pixels where the interior mask is covered (props, panels); at most 2 % keeps the interior clear. Only measured where the mask is needed
D37 record (R1): the share of changed pixels where the mask is not covered (the windows); the frost belongs here
D37 (R1, required): interior props stay clear (changed share inside the mask at most 2 %), or the interior is drawn past the upscaler and covers the composite by itself
D37 record (R12): correlation of the change the frost made with the predicted opacity map (FrostShape.AlphaMap), as drawn
D37 record (R12): the same correlation with the prediction turned over vertically

D37 (R12, required): the correlation as drawn exceeds the turned one by more than 0.02, i.e. frost.flipY resolved to the right orientation and the frost is not mirrored vertically. The margin 0.02 is a first value: the first run sets the real one
D37 A/B control for the quad fallback (forced with frost.forceQuad and frost.quadWithUpscaler): as the host control
D37 A/B (R3): the forced quad is visible in the upscaled image, at least 1 % of the pixels changed; the fallback draws something where the policy lets it
D37 record (R3): an upscaler runs on the picture during the policy check below
